findings.note: set once, then stable: fine if it is a cache that is safe to share between threads.

notes.per-test: changes while tests run, so concurrent tests see each other's value. Make it per lane (a contextvar), or mark the tests lanes_exclusive.
notes.patched: patched while a test runs; under lanes the patch is visible to every test in the process. Mark the test lanes_exclusive, or patch something lane-local.
notes.grows: grows with every test: check that it is thread-safe and that nothing reads its last entry as 'the current test'.
notes.set-once: set once, then stable: fine if it is a cache that is safe to share between threads.
